name: Account activated
description: Confirms an account is fully active after verification or approval, and states exactly what is now available.

origin.note: Design: certificate — no imagery, rule-led, account facts set as a record.

subject: Your {{ product.name }} account is active
preheader: Everything is unlocked. Here is where to start and who to ask for help.

account_email.description: The address the account is tied to. Restating it surfaces a typo now rather than at the next sign-in.

account_id.description: Account or workspace reference, if you have one worth quoting to support.

activated_at.description: When activation completed, in the recipient's own timezone if you know it.

unlocked.description: What is available now. Concrete capabilities, three or fewer.

support_note.description: Where to get help, phrased as an invitation rather than a deflection.
support_note.default: If something doesn't work the way you expected, reply and tell us what you were trying to do.

keep_note.description: Why this email is worth keeping. A confirmation that says so gets filed instead of deleted.
keep_note.default: Worth keeping: this message has the details support will ask for.
